steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each commentary claim is matched to the figure behind it, and each total is checked.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Balance sheet does not balance
findings.fix: Find the imbalance before the pack is issued

findings.title: Commentary claim with no figure behind it
findings.fix: Add the figure or remove the claim

findings.title: Total does not match its lines

outcome.notChecked: The statutory accounting treatment; judgements in the accounts.
